preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n representing the number of polyhedrons, where 1 ≤ n ≤ 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(line.strip() in ['Tetrahedron', 'Cube', 'Octahedron', 'Dodecahedron', 'Icosahedron'] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the following n lines contains a string representing one of the five valid polyhedron names.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().isdigit() and int(stdout.strip()) == sum(4 if line.strip() == 'Tetrahedron' else 6 if line.strip() == 'Cube' else 8 if line.strip() == 'Octahedron' else 12 if line.strip() == 'Dodecahedron' else 20 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: The output is the total number of faces in all polyhedrons, computed as the sum of faces for each polyhedron: 4 for Tetrahedron, 6 for Cube, 8 for Octahedron, 12 for Dodecahedron, and 20 for Icosahedron.
